rec.name: Free Gift Progress Bar with Quantity-Locked Gift Line Item (Cart Drawer)
rec.status: Built — launched as A/B test; quantity-selector bug fixed 2025-06-30

what.text: A free-gift incentive in the cart drawer. A progress bar with two milestones (a free-shipping truck icon at mid-point and a gift icon at the end) shows how close the customer is to a reward. Once the threshold is reached, a message reads 'Congratulations! Add your free gift!'. The gift then appears as a normal cart line item named '<Product> - FREE GIFT'. It shows the variant (e.g. 'Veredelung: Gold') and the price as 'Kostenlos' (free) next to the struck-through original price (€19.90). The gift's quantity is capped at 1 and its quantity selector is disabled.

why.text: Reward-based progress bars use the goal-gradient effect: customers add items to reach the next milestone, which raises AOV. A free gift reframes the spend as a gain, and the struck-through €19.90 next to 'Free' anchors its perceived value. Capping the gift at 1 keeps the offer credible and protects margin; allowing several free gifts would break the logic of the promotion.

how.text: 1) Add a multi-step progress bar to the cart drawer, with icon milestones for free shipping and the gift, driven by cart subtotal versus the thresholds. 2) Show a congratulation message when the gift threshold is reached. 3) Add the gift product/variant to the cart as a line item priced at €0 (via discount or a zero-price gift variant) and label it 'FREE GIFT' with 'Kostenlos' plus the struck-through compare-at price. 4) Lock the gift line's quantity to a maximum of 1 by disabling the +/- selector (greyed out, fixed at 1). The ticket confirms the fix was made to the quantity selector; the exact mechanism is not described. 5) Optionally harden the lock against quantity changes via cart AJAX calls and against removing the gift while the threshold is still met.

items: Gift product and variant (e.g. Twisted Hoops, Gold)
Quantity selector on the gift line: disabled/greyed out
Progress-bar message text before and after the threshold is reached

dependencies.text: A cart drawer theme with a progress bar and line-item rendering. A gift product/variant with a compare-at price of €19.90, so the strikethrough can show. Logic to add or price the gift at €0 (discount, cart transform or script). The method is not stated in the ticket. The screenshots also show other cart-drawer modules (a reservation timer banner, a 'Passt perfekt dazu' cross-sell and a payment-icon row), but these are not part of this element.

items: Share of orders reaching the gift threshold
Conversion rate (cart to checkout, checkout to order)
Margin per order, including gift cost
Number of orders with a gift quantity above 1 (should be 0)

images.caption: Cart drawer with the free-gift progress bar and the 'Twisted Hoops - FREE GIFT' line item at €0 (struck-through €19.90). The quantity shows 2 and the selector is still active. This is the bug state before the fix.
Fixed state: the gift line's quantity is 1 and the +/- selector is greyed out (circled in red). Regular items keep an active selector.
